deleteBooks.question: Remove these books or remaining files?
deleteBooks.description:
This permanently removes the listed books and their source files. This cannot be undone.

{{subject}}

deleteBook.question: Delete “{{subject}}” from your shelf?
deleteBook.description: This permanently removes the imported source file and its local reading data. This cannot be undone.

manageEntity.question: Change this identity?
manageEntity.description:
Apply the exact entity decision below. Resolve edits the named original member; merge keeps the displayed canonical identity. Original definitions and aliases remain, and merges cannot be split here. These global changes may sync to your other devices. Approve only identities you recognize.

{{subject}}

updateProfile.question: Replace your profile?
updateProfile.description:
Replace your profile summary with the text below. Empty text clears the summary. This affects future conversations and, when sync is enabled, your other devices. It does not remove memories, transcripts or backups.

{{subject}}

downloadResource.question: Download this file?
downloadResource.description:
Request the URL below and store up to 64 MiB temporarily in this conversation. No credentials are sent and redirects require another approval. The content may later be read into this conversation or saved through a separate dialog.

{{subject}}

pluginTool.question: Run this plugin tool?
pluginTool.description:
The plugin may change or delete data. Approve only this call with the arguments shown below; this does not grant additional permissions.

{{subject}}

mergeBooks.question: Merge these duplicate books?
mergeBooks.description:
The first record is kept. Annotations and reading data follow the host's merge rules; chat transcripts keep their original references. This cannot be undone and does not reclaim files immediately.

{{subject}}

importResource.question: Add this file to your shelf?
importResource.description: Import {{subject}} through the normal library pipeline. The original stays unchanged. Library data follows your existing sync settings.

accessBookFile.question: Prepare the original book file?
accessBookFile.description: Create a temporary export reference for {{subject}}. The original stays unchanged. You will choose the save destination separately; book bytes are not sent to the model.

manageSchedule.question: Apply this schedule action?
manageSchedule.description: {{subject}}. Pause and resume persist on this device. Running may perform the plugin's normal network or data operations; completed effects are not undone.

syncNow.question: Sync now?
syncNow.description: Sync this device with the configured encrypted account. Cancelling the request will not undo completed transfers.

clearConversation.question: Clear this conversation?
clearConversation.description:
{{subject}}

Stops its current reply and removes the transcript and cached conversation insights. Long-term memories, event history and completed actions are not erased.

deleteCollection.question: Delete the collection “{{subject}}”?
deleteCollection.description: The collection will be removed. Its books will stay on your shelf without a collection.

generateBookGraph.question: Generate this book's graph?

classifyBook.question: Change this book's classification?
classifyBook.description:
{{subject}}

Expository classification removes chapter spoiler boundaries and changes the graph style. Existing digests rebuild lazily; past answers and in-flight work are not undone.

manageMemory.question: Review this memory change?
manageMemory.description:
{{subject}}

Only the shown change will be applied. Forgetting stops active retrieval; event history is retained.

deleteAnnotation.question: Delete this annotation?
deleteAnnotation.description: “{{subject}}” will be permanently removed from your reading context.

deleteBookmark.question: Delete this bookmark?
deleteBookmark.description: “{{subject}}” will be removed from this book’s bookmarks.

completeOnboarding.question: Save your reading profile?
completeOnboarding.description:
The complete profile below and the listed memories will be saved together on this device and may sync to your other devices. Nothing is saved until you approve.

{{subject}}

manageJob.question: Run this saved task?
manageJob.description: The displayed steps execute in order and may continue after restart. Cancellation stops later work; it does not undo completed changes.

atomicTransaction.question: Apply this transaction?
atomicTransaction.description: The displayed local changes commit together only if the preview is still current. Undo is also conditional and will not overwrite later changes.

externalLink.title: Open external link?
externalLink.description: This link will open in your default browser.

empty.description: Select a passage and choose Ask AI, or just start typing. This conversation stays with the book.
